title: Lula Will Visit Mexico, Foreign Secretary Velasco Confirms
author: Dora Villanueva
content:
_This article by[Dora
Villanueva](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Dora%20Villanueva) originally
appeared in the [October 28, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/28/politica/lula-confirma-
visita-a-mexico-sre), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

The President of Brazil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, **confirmed to President
Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo that he will come to Mexico** , Foreign Secretary
Roberto Velasco Álvarez announced.

On Monday, after the president's **historic victory in the electoral runoff**
, Sheinbaum Pardo reported that she had a telephone conversation with her
counterpart. In it they agreed to meet soon.

> Besides reporting that the visit will not remain an intention, "President
> Lula confirmed to President Sheinbaum that he will come to Mexico," Velasco
> Álvarez reiterated that the federal government is glad about the Brazilian
> leader's victory.

In addition, several projects are being promoted jointly, "both on the
multilateral and the commercial level, with the aim of continuing to
strengthen our partnership in Latin America."

> We are promoting several projects jointly; the most relevant is a strategic
> alliance between Pemex and Petrobras. Of course, our laws and our
> Constitution establish certain limits, but we are working with them within
> this framework.
>
> Foreign Secretary Roberto Velasco Álvarez
